events.title: Mondo Chick
events.notes: Appears at each full UTC hour. It can be defeated early and otherwise leaves after 15 minutes; use the shared timer for the next spawn.

events.title: Natural Puffshrooms
events.notes: Natural spawns occur at :15 and :45 each hour. Player-planter spawns are separate; see the shared timer.

timerPresets.title: Mondo Chick spawn
timerPresets.notes: Full UTC hour. The boss may already have been defeated in your server.

timerPresets.title: Natural Puffshroom spawn
timerPresets.notes: At :15 and :45 each UTC hour. Planter-triggered spawns are not predicted.
